bug.actual_behavior: The ZIP extracts pandoc.exe directly under the version folder, but the installer requires bin/pandoc and exits with binary not found after installation.
evidence: Official Windows archive extracted pandoc.exe at pandoc-3.8.3/pandoc.exe, while _install_pandoc_zip returns pandoc-3.8.3/bin/pandoc.
bug.expected_behavior: Auto-install should locate pandoc.exe from the official Windows ZIP and continue rendering.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run knit_rmd_html.py for an Rmd when pandoc is absent from PATH on Windows.
Observe successful archive download followed by pandoc binary not found after installation.
bug.summary: Windows Pandoc 3.8.3 ZIP layout is incompatible with installer path assumption
bug.workaround: Prepend the actual extracted pandoc.exe directory to PATH and rerun the wrapper with --no-install.
